what: Phase cues spoken by a narrator outside the debate. The same three files are used for every debate. Each one tells the model that a phase has ended, in the words of the system prompt, so the model knows to open the next phase.
voice: male, neutral, held out of the dataset voice pool (Sidon-restored NaturalVoices reference MSP-PODCAST_6100, UTMOS 4.46); it appears in no debate

cue_openings_over.mp3.when: right after the second opening ends (the model should open the crossfire)

cue_crossfire_over.mp3.when: at crossfire start + 150 s (the model should open the closings)
